note: Method-control claims for planted Haladyna/Downing/Rodriguez item-writing flaws. Not an operational assessment tag.

claims.text: Planted flaw: the keyed option is uniquely longest.
claims.operationalization: A cue program that picks the uniquely longest option should recover the key on held-out planted items.

claims.text: Planted flaw: the keyed option uniquely repeats a distinctive stem token.
claims.operationalization: A stem-option overlap program should recover the key on held-out planted items.

claims.text: Planted flaw: every distractor uses an absolute term; the key does not.
claims.operationalization: A program that avoids absolute terms should recover the key on held-out planted items.

claims.text: Planted flaw: the key is always option C.
claims.operationalization: A position-C program should recover the key on held-out planted items.

claims.text: Planted flaw: the stem ends in the article a and only the key begins with a consonant.
claims.operationalization: A grammatical-agreement program should recover the key on held-out planted items.

claims.text: Planted flaw: distractors are non-words; the key is an English word.
claims.operationalization: A specificity / English-word program should recover the key on held-out planted items.

claims.text: Matched clean items with no planted unique cue.
claims.operationalization: No cue program should clear the witness bar on the held-out clean set.
